title: AI QA Engineer
description:
**About Us:**

At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.

And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.

Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/

**Quick Take**

As an AI QA Engineer, you’ll drive the quality, reliability, and safety of the AI solutions we deliver to our Global 2000 clients, including GenAI and agentic applications, RAG pipelines, and ML models used across our products. This role is for an engineer with a solid data science/AI background who understands how models behave and is skilled in LLM evaluation, end-to-end AI testing, and ML model validation, helping us ship production-grade AI with confidence.

**The Work**

* Own the test strategy for our AI products, covering LLM features, agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, and ML models.
* Write and execute test plans, cases, and reports; manage the defect lifecycle; and perform exploratory testing of AI features.
* Define acceptance criteria and quality metrics for non-deterministic outputs (accuracy, groundedness, hallucination rate, relevance, cost) using LLM-as-a-judge and human evaluation.
* Build and maintain golden datasets, ground-truth labels, and regression suites with subject-matter experts, reflecting real scenarios and edge cases.
* Develop automated evaluation pipelines (DeepEval, Ragas, promptfoo, LangSmith) that run in CI/CD on every prompt, model, retrieval, or code change.
* Test agentic behavior—multi-step planning, tool calling, integrations, error handling, and fallbacks—to verify agents’ complete tasks correctly and stay within guardrails.
* Validate ML models and data pipelines for data quality, segment performance, bias/fairness, and drift, using statistical methods to compare versions.
* Perform adversarial and safety testing: prompt injection, jailbreaks, PII leakage, and compliance checks.
* Monitor production AI quality through observability tooling, triage degradations, lead root-cause analysis, and partner with Data Science, AI, and engineering teams on fixes and release sign-off.

**The Must-Haves**

* B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Data Science, ML/AI, Statistics, or related field.
* 2–3 years in AI/ML, data science, or AI-focused QA, including 1+ year of hands-on test automation, ideally for production ML systems.
* Working knowledge of ML model building, evaluation metrics, and LLM behavior (prompting, context, RAG).
* Experience evaluating GenAI applications (RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, function calling) with DeepEval, Ragas, or similar.
* Strong Python with PyTest, API testing, and CI/CD integration.
* Grounding in statistics and experimentation (sampling, significance testing, model A/B comparison), plus SQL and data validation tools such as Great Expectations or Evidently.
* Experience testing document and image analysis solutions that extract insights from unstructured data.
* Ability to define pass/fail criteria and rubrics for non-deterministic outputs and translate business requirements into measurable quality standards.
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical and business stakeholders across time zones.

**The Good-to-Haves**

* Synthetic test data generation, including privacy-safe datasets, edge cases, and adversarial scenarios.
* Docker, Kubernetes, and MLOps tooling for deploying and testing AI applications.
* Familiarity with AI risk and governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act) and responsible AI practices (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, bias testing, PII protection).
* Working knowledge of LangChain, LangGraph, Hugging Face, or similar, plus LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, open-source models).
* UI and end-to-end test automation (Playwright, Selenium) for AI-driven interfaces.

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/

**Benefits**

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.

With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
WritingJob Description: Software Test Engineer / QA EngineerJob Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and quality-driven **Software Test Engineer / QA Engineer** to ensure the functionality, reliability, security, and performance of enterprise software applications. The candidate will collaborate with developers, technical leads, product teams, business analysts, and UI/UX designers to identify defects, validate application workflows, improve test coverage, and deliver high-quality software solutions.

The role involves manual testing, API testing, database validation, test automation, performance testing, and software quality assurance throughout the software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities1. Manual and Functional Testing

* Analyze business requirements and technical specifications to prepare test scenarios, test cases, and test plans.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, sanity, and end-to-end testing.
* Validate application workflows, user interfaces, forms, reports, and business rules.
* Identify, document, track, and verify software defects throughout the testing lifecycle.
* Ensure test coverage across positive, negative, boundary, and exception scenarios.
* Conduct GUI testing and backend testing to verify application functionality and data accuracy.
* Perform user acceptance testing (UAT) support and release validation.

2. API and Database Testing

* Test REST APIs using Postman or similar API testing tools.
* Validate API requests, responses, HTTP status codes, authentication, authorization, and error handling.
* Perform database testing and data validation using SQL and PostgreSQL.
* Verify data consistency, integrity, and accuracy across application modules.
* Test integrations with third-party applications and enterprise systems.
* Identify API and database-related issues and coordinate with development teams for resolution.

3. Test Automation

* Develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar frameworks.
* Automate repetitive functional and regression test cases to improve testing efficiency.
* Maintain reusable test scripts and automation frameworks.
* Identify suitable test cases for automation based on application requirements and testing priorities.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines where applicable.
* Collaborate with developers to improve test coverage and reduce manual testing effort.

4. Performance, Security, and Quality Assurance

* Support performance and load testing using JMeter or similar tools.
* Evaluate application responsiveness, stability, and performance under different workloads.
* Validate authentication, authorization, access controls, and session management.
* Identify potential application security vulnerabilities and coordinate remediation with development teams.
* Apply relevant security testing practices, including awareness of the OWASP Top 10.
* Participate in defect triage, root-cause analysis, and release-readiness reviews.
* Prepare test execution reports, defect summaries, and quality assessment documentation.

5. Team Collaboration and Documentation

* Work closely with developers, business analysts, product managers, technical leads, and UI/UX designers.
* Participate in sprint planning, requirement reviews, daily stand-ups, and sprint retrospectives.
* Support UAT, production validation, and release testing activities.
* Maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, defect logs, and other QA documentation.
* Track testing progress and communicate risks, blockers, and quality concerns to stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes and quality standards.

Candidate Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience in software testing or quality assurance; the stated experience range is **2–7 years**, subject to confirmation.
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, SDLC, and STLC.
* Hands-on experience in manual, functional, regression, and integration testing.
* Practical experience with API testing using Postman or similar tools.
* Knowledge of SQL and database testing, preferably with PostgreSQL.
* Familiarity with automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress.
* Understanding of defect tracking, test documentation, and root-cause analysis.
* Knowledge of performance testing, security testing, and CI/CD workflows is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Agile and Scrum development methodologies.
* Strong analytical, communication, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple testing activities.

Required Technical Skills

* **Manual Testing:** Functional, Regression, Integration, Smoke, Sanity, End-to-End, GUI, and Backend Testing
* **API Testing:** Postman, REST APIs, Request/Response Validation, Authentication, and Authorization
* **Database Testing:** SQL, PostgreSQL, Data Validation, and Data Integrity
* **Automation Testing:** Selenium, Playwright, Cypress
* **Performance Testing:** JMeter, Load Testing, and Performance Testing
* **Security Testing:** Access Control Validation, Session Management, and OWASP Top 10 Awareness
* **Programming Languages:** Python, Java, JavaScript
* **Development Tools:** Git, Docker, CI/CD
* **Test Management:** Jira, Defect Tracking, Test Case Design, and Test Documentation
* **Methodologies:** SDLC, STLC, Agile, Scrum, UAT, and Root Cause Analysis

Job Details

* **Job Title:** Software Test Engineer / QA Engineer
* **Experience:** 2–7 Years (to be confirmed)
* **Qualification:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field
* **Job Domain:** Software Testing and Quality Assurance
* **Core Focus:** Manual Testing, API Testing, Database Testing, Automation, Performance, and Security
* **Work Environment:** Cross-functional collaboration with engineering, product, and technical teams

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: QA Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

This is a QA Engineer role on our Quality Engineering team. You'll be embedded directly alongside a product development pod, owning quality outcomes for that surface area; manual testing and automation are not separate functions here; you'll do both.

You'll report to the QA Engineering Manager and work closely with developers, product managers, and your pod as a real partner in shipping quality software, not a downstream checkpoint.

AI tooling has changed what QA can do day-to-day. We expect you to actively use agentic tools like Claude Code, Kiro, or Codex to help generate and maintain tests. You don't need to have architected pipelines from scratch, but you should be comfortable using these tools as part of your daily workflow.

**What You'll Own**

**Your Pod**

● Serve as the QA owner for your dev pod, test strategy, automation coverage, and quality sign-off for your team's features

● Grow your automation depth and agentic tooling fluency over time

● Take ownership incrementally as you build trust and track record

**Quality Execution**

● Write and maintain test cases across manual and automated coverage for your pod's features

● Help ensure shift-left practices, automation coverage, and clear quality gates are part of the definition of done

● Surface quality risks to your dev team and PM early before code ships, not after

● Track relevant quality metrics for your area: defect leakage, escaped defects, automation coverage, regression stability

**AI-Assisted QA Engineering**

● Use agentic tools (Claude Code, Kiro, Codex, or similar) to help generate test cases, triage CI failures, and maintain regression suites

● Validate AI-generated test output for correctness you're responsible for what ships, even when a tool helped write it
